auth.signInIntro: Sign in to Cubora to continue.

landing.badge: Talent, services and production — from Cuba to the world
landing.categoriesIntro: Talent, services, and products and production — discoverable through one conversation.
landing.categoriesTitle: One catalog, three ways to work with Cuba
landing.description: Cubora is a commercial intermediary, not a directory. Tell us what you need — talent, a service, a product, or production capacity — and we help you find it, verify it, and agree terms through Cubora.
landing.footerNote: Cubora connects Cuban talent, services, products and production with buyers around the world.
landing.howStep1Text: Tell us in plain language — a role, a service, a product, or capacity to produce it.
landing.howStep2Text: Cubora identifies real suppliers and checks them before anything is presented as available.
landing.howStep3Text: Questions, quotations and proposals run through Cubora. Contact details are shared only once the agreed conditions are met.
landing.productsText: Physical goods, agricultural products, producers, manufacturers and production capacity.
landing.sealText: Products genuinely made, grown or manufactured in Cuba carry the Made in Cuba seal. Origin is verified before the seal is awarded — and origin verification is separate from any quality claim.
landing.servicesText: Individuals and businesses offering services, from creative production to technical work.
landing.tagline: Born from ingenuity. Built through resilience. Made in Cuba.
landing.talentText: Professionals and independent specialists — developers, designers, marketers, engineers and more.

onboarding.completeIntro: A few questions so we can match you to the right work.
onboarding.kindNote: You can add business details to your profile later.
onboarding.kindTitle: Is this account for you, or for a business?
onboarding.roleConsumerDesc: Find Cuban talent, services and products.
onboarding.roleConsumerTitle: I want to buy or hire
onboarding.roleNote: One account can do both. Pick what you want to do first — you can activate the other role later from your profile.
onboarding.roleProviderDesc: Share your work and get discovered.
onboarding.roleTitle: What do you want to do first?

roles.consumerDesc: Buy and hire — request talent, services and products.
roles.providerDesc: Offer work — talent, services, products and production.

discovery.emptyHint: Try “I need a React developer in Havana” or “I need 500 kg of Cuban coffee per month”.
discovery.partialNote: Preliminary matches — answer above to narrow the search.
discovery.sourcingCreated: No matching offer yet — your request “{query}” was saved as a sourcing request. Cubora will let you know when a real opportunity appears.
discovery.unavailable: AI discovery is unavailable right now. Try the catalog instead.

discover.intro: Describe what you need — a developer, a service, a product, production capacity. Cubora searches the catalog, asks only when it needs to, and shows matching offers right here. Listings show what providers state they can offer; export, payment, and delivery are verified per operation, never implied by a listing.
discover.title: Discover

catalog.intro: Cuban talent, services, products, and production capacity — one catalog, one search. Listings show what providers state they can offer; export, payment, and delivery are verified per operation, never implied by a listing.
catalog.noResults: No offers match these filters yet. The catalog grows as providers publish offers — and when nothing matches, a sourcing request is the Phase 3 answer, not an invented listing.
catalog.offerVerificationPending: Provider verification pending — Cubora verifies providers before the seal or a verified badge is shown.
catalog.semanticIntro: Semantic search understands the meaning of your request, not just keywords. It searches talent profiles today; offer-level semantic search lands with Phase 3.
catalog.semanticMinLength: Describe what you need in at least 3 characters.
catalog.semanticNoResults: No talent profiles matched. Try different words, or use the structured filters above.
catalog.semanticPlaceholder: e.g. a coffee producer in Santiago who can ship 500 kg a month
catalog.semanticUnavailable: Semantic search is unavailable right now.
catalog.title: Catalog

offers.activateIntro: Offering work on Cubora — talent, services, products, or production capacity — needs the provider role. One account can do both: activate offering below and your provider profile appears here.
offers.categoryFixed: The category is fixed once an offer exists — create a new offer for a different category.
offers.descriptionPlaceholder: What you offer, in your own words.
offers.editHint: To edit an offer, use its Edit button — the form below creates a new one.
offers.intro: Your provider profile and your offers. Offers start as drafts and only appear in the catalog once you publish them. Verification and the Made in Cuba seal are decided by Cubora operations, not here.
offers.languagesProvider: Languages you work in (comma-separated, e.g. es, en)
offers.negotiationsEmpty: No negotiations yet. When a buyer requests a quotation on your offer, or operations matches your offer to a sourcing request, the conversation starts here.
offers.noOffers: No offers yet. Create your first offer below — it starts as a draft, and you publish it when it is ready.
offers.offerNotYours: That offer does not exist or is not yours.
offers.originDetailPlaceholder: e.g. Grown in Santiago de Cuba
offers.originNote: Origin is a claim you make; the Made in Cuba seal is awarded only after Cubora verifies it.
offers.originPlaceholder: Where the work or goods come from
offers.productsNote: Quantities and capacity describe what you state you can supply. Nothing here promises export, payment, or delivery — those are verified per operation.
offers.title: My offers
offers.verificationIntro: Verification is decided by Cubora operations from the evidence you provide. What counts as “verified” is still an open product decision (spec O6).
offers.verificationPendingNote: — Cubora verifies providers before the verified badge is shown.

operations.blockedNotice: This negotiation is blocked pending a compliance review by Cubora operations. You will hear from operations when the review is resolved.
operations.contactHidden: Contact details stay hidden until Cubora operations approves a release. Communication happens here, through Cubora, until then.
operations.contactReleased: Contact has been released for this operation. Cubora approved the release
operations.conversationEmpty: No messages yet — say hello through Cubora.
operations.feesEmpty: No fees recorded. A fee is recorded per operation by Cubora operations, with exactly what was agreed.
operations.feesEmptyDetail: No fees recorded for this operation yet.
operations.intro: Your requests, negotiations, and agreed operations. Cubora mediates every step — contact details are shared only after an approved release.
operations.negotiationsBuyerEmpty: No negotiations yet. Request a quotation on a catalog offer and the conversation starts here.
operations.negotiationsProviderEmpty: No opportunities in negotiation. When a buyer requests a quotation on your offer, or ops matches your offer to a sourcing request, it appears here.
operations.notFoundIntro: Either it does not exist, or it is not yours.
operations.proposalSummaryPlaceholder: Summary (what you are offering, in plain words)
operations.requestsEmpty: No sourcing requests. When a search finds nothing, Cubora creates one and looks for a supplier for you.
operations.title: My operations
